title: Visual Algorithm & Graph Lectures
subtitle: Master complex LeetCode problems through visual animations, YouTube lectures, and architectural state diagrams.
description: In-depth visual algorithmic explanations covering 34 core LeetCode problems across Graphs, Grids, Topological Sorting, Disjoint Set Union, Sliding Windows, and Monotonic Stacks.

modules.title: Module 1: Breadth-First Search & Grid Graph Visualizations
modules.description: Master 2D grid pathfinding, multi-source BFS, and connected component traversal with step-by-step visual walk-throughs.

modules.title: Module 2: Depth-First Search, DAGs & Topological Sorting
modules.description: Explore recursive graph exploration, cycle detection, topological dependency ordering with Kahn's algorithm, and Dijkstra's shortest paths.

modules.title: Module 3: Disjoint Set Union (DSU) & Spanning Trees
modules.description: Master disjoint set forests, path compression, union by rank, cycle detection in undirected graphs, and tree pointers.

modules.title: Module 4: Sliding Window, Monotonic Stacks & Prefix Difference Arrays
modules.description: Deep dive into array difference techniques, monotonic stack sequences, dynamic programming, and greedy optimization patterns.
